title: Machine Learning Engineer Bootcamp: From Fundamentals to Production
description: A project-based course that builds the practical skills needed to land a Machine Learning Engineer role, covering Python, math foundations, ML algorithms, PyTorch, feature engineering, model training and evaluation, and production-ready data pipelines. Learners build a portfolio of hands-on projects culminating in an end-to-end ML system.
audience: Aspiring Machine Learning Engineers with basic programming exposure who want to bridge résumé gaps and become job-ready for ML engineering roles.

moduleTitles.1: Foundations: Python and Math for ML
moduleTitles.4: Production ML: Pipelines, Evaluation, and Capstone
moduleTitles.5: LLM Engineering: Transformers, RAG, and Fine-Tuning
